# Fluffle Puff

Fluffle Puff is a huge, cheerful ball of pale-pink fur with bright turquoise eyes, tiny hooves, and a protruding tongue. She's the affectionate troublemaker who keeps Queen Chrysalis on her toes in *Ask Fluffle Puff* and *Fluffle Puff Tales*. Created by Mixermike622 (FluffyMixer), she belongs to the creator's *My Little Pony*-inspired fan/parody continuity, not Hasbro's *Friendship Is Magic* TV continuity. The creator later reworked her for an independent continuation, *Floof n Friends*. [Creator's account](https://www.patreon.com/cw/fluffle_puff)

- *Name and origins:* “Fluffle Puff” comes from the title of Mixermike622's original DeviantArt drawing, posted January 3, 2012. It became the character's creator-used name, not an official G4 character name. “ChryssiPuff” refers to her affectionate pairing with Chrysalis, not a second identity. [Origin history](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/fluffle-puff)
- *Voice:* Usually communicates through raspberries (“pffft”), squeaks, gasps, and expressive noises rather than dialogue. FluffyMixer explicitly credited themself with Fluffle's noises; no separate regular speaking actor is verified. [Creator's “EG” video and credits](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KwxuMMlAbAQ)
- *Appearances:* The *Dan vs FiM* and *Ask Fluffle Puff* Tumblr comics, the creator's animated *Fluffle Puff Tales* shorts, and their three-part fan *Equestria Girls* parody. Her unicorn horn in “PFUDOR” is a costume prop, not a revealed unicorn form.

## Important moments

*Season/episode numbers below follow a third-party [episode index](https://thetvdb.com/series/fluffle-puff-tales/allseasons/official), not a Hasbro broadcast schedule. All links are creator-uploaded complete shorts; exact scene timestamps could not be verified.*

1. *A doughnut breaks the ice — “Kiss Kiss” (S1E4).* Fluffle feeds Chrysalis a doughnut and licks icing from her face, leaving the normally forbidding queen blushing. [Watch the short](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L9LCLktP_g4) — timestamp unavailable.
2. *The pink fluffy unicorn dance — “PFUDOR” (special 0x2).* Fluffle dons a pretend horn and dances on a makeshift rainbow to Andrew Huang's song, creating her most recognizable musical gag. [Watch the short](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qRC4Vk6kisY) — timestamp unavailable.
3. *A gift made of her own fluff — “Chrysmas Special” (S1E10).* To help Chrysalis enjoy snowy weather, Fluffle shears her fur into a warm coat for the queen. [Watch the short](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lplUHZEaPrM) — timestamp unavailable.
4. *Time together on Valentine's Day — “Special Someponies” (S1E11).* Fluffle and Chrysalis spend the holiday together, putting their unusual but affectionate bond at the center of the story. [Watch the short](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pIVEe5bsV-w) — timestamp unavailable.
